revision_policy: upstream default branch HEAD frozen before execution
comparison: source-audit discovery; distinguish raw static candidates, tool-internal validation, and independently confirmed results
mygoldmine_mode: stage-II audit only; no prior runs or learned skills from these targets
repoaudit_scope: NPD, MLK, UAF; 1200 seconds per category; preserve separate category results
claude_security_review_mode: adapted full-source review; no GitHub comments or synthetic PR publication
strix_mode: full-source, standard mode, USD 10 estimated cost cap
codex_security_mode: adapted custom provider; 360 Responses API; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
publication: aggregated results only; raw findings and traces excluded
timing_limitation: concurrent shared-host execution and unequal native sandbox defaults; wall times are operational observations, not controlled speed benchmarks
